scope: separate authenticated Rocky tool-image preparation, one offline constrained exact-build owner, and a local adapter preserving the workflow exact-build shell bodies
original_failures: The canonical GitHub workflow dispatch was independently BLOCKED because it did not prove the frozen host profile, mixed network acquisition with compilation, launched downstream jobs and lacked a local owner/lease receipt.
The first preparation draft trusted claims, used an undefined evidence variable and had two test errors.
The first runtime-owner draft trusted requested resource/readback values, could release while a timed-out container remained live and did not mount a usable driver.
The first offline-driver draft could report PASS without a kernel or module and omitted most patch, configuration and post-build validation closure.
The first real full-manifest generation exposed additional gitlinks beyond ihk; treating every tracked index entry as a regular file failed on a gitlink directory.
bounded_corrections: One bounded correction was attempted for each draft family and remained insufficient; the family was escalated rather than repeatedly weakening oracles.

The expert replacement reuses the exact named workflow source, acquisition/stage, configuration, compilation and post-provenance validator bodies. Only network acquisition and GitHub service provenance are adapted.
Preparation receives no source mount, validates exact base/tool/RPM/OS identities and retains a source-free immutable image receipt.
The runtime owner measures resources, verifies actual Docker profile/mounts/UID/image/driver, runs one network-none cap-drop-all container and retains the lease until terminal retirement is proven.
The offline driver binds every tracked superproject/submodule file and all four source assets, rejects dirty inputs, streams phase evidence and cannot PASS without the exact artifact/checksum set.
The bounded real-input correction now binds every gitlink by exact Git object ID, recursively binds the consumed ihk files, and does not require unrelated submodules to be materialized.

After the independent preparation BLOCK, each Docker client command writes directly to retained stdout/stderr files; CLI-only TERM/INT handling drives bounded retirement and atomic failure receipts, while uncertain retirement keeps the lease.

remaining_prerequisites: Independent source and execution review must approve the exact networked preparation capabilities and cleanup before it runs.
A clean self-contained candidate checkout, full repository/assets manifest and extracted debrand asset must be created and hash-bound.
The prepared image and the subsequent offline heavy build require distinct reviewed execution releases.
Full production RPM/signature closure remains unclaimed.
limitations: No Docker preparation, configured build, module load, guest, application, production gate or whole-OS acceptance is claimed.
